title: The New York Times Is Running for Reporting
summary: The Times is helping support a new generation of journalists by raising money for the Craig Newmark Graduate School of Journalism’s free tuition at the New York City Marathon.
body_markdown:
The Times is helping support a new generation of journalists by raising money for the Craig Newmark Graduate School of Journalism’s free tuition campaign at the N.Y.C. Marathon.


The Times’s Run for Reporting funds CUNY scholarships to ensure a career in journalism remains accessible to all.


The Times is marking its 175th anniversary by supporting the journalism industry — raising awareness for the need for more reporting nationwide and cultivating the next generation of journalists.


You can donate to the CUNY J-School Free Tuition campaign


[here](https://onecau.se/_m9pb51) .


Interested in running for reporting? Join our Strava Run for Reporting Run Club and run in support of CUNY or the journalistic nonprofit of your choice.
